verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, API, or agent connectivity, and probes for llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. The Gusto integration is a product-to-product sync, not an agent-facing MCP server, so it earns no credit.
